payload.summary: Cross-viewport: calculator/modal close and control hit-layer interception
payload.detail: Phone, tablet, and desktop: calculator/PHQ-9 modal close or controls can be pointer-intercepted by overlay/content (duplicate close targets; wrapper interception). Visible close often still works. Next: single unambiguous close hit target ≥44px above content; fix PHQ-9 control hit testing. Evidence: DESIGN-SIZING-*; desktop calculator-phq9-modal; DS-03 / LQA-P2-04 / LQA-T-07.
